actual.description: The money accounts' balance at that day, from the ledger now.

difference.description: Actual less projected: below zero, less cash came than the projection said.

projected.description: The balance the projection gave at the window's end.

receipts_later.description: Invoices the projection expected in the window that were not settled by its end, signed as the cash moved.

taken_on.description: The day it was taken: its first day is the projection's today.

timing.description: Bills expected in the window not paid by its end, and invoices or bills expected after it that settled inside it.

unplanned.description: The rest: spend and receipts the projection did not hold, recurring occurrences and batches, and anything else that moved cash. The three causes add to the difference exactly.

weeks.description: How many weeks later it is compared.

window_end.description: The last day of that week.
